business_summary: Grand Ocean Advanced Resources Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sale of coal and minerals in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company engages in coal-related operations at the Inner Mongolia mine in China. It also provides management services. The company was formerly known as DeTeam Company Limited and changed its name to Grand Ocean Advanced Resources Company Limited in July 2015. Grand Ocean Advanced Resources Company Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Grand Ocean Advanced Resources Company Limited는 홍콩과 중화인민공화국에서 석탄과 광물의 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 당사는 중국 내몽골 광산에서 석탄 관련 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 관리 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 DeTeam Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2015년 7월에 Grand Ocean Advanced Resources Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Grand Ocean Advanced Resources Company Limited는 1996년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
